name: 15% Solutions
deliverable: Immediate identification of autonomous individual actions requiring no budget

steps.text: Ask each person what 15 percent they can do now with the authority and resources they hold.
Have everyone write one action in silence that needs no budget, permission, or anyone's decision.
Share in pairs, then name your first step and help.

failure: The group drifts into the 85 percent: everyone lists what leadership must change, not their own move.
intervention: Park the blockers on a separate list, then ask again what each person can do this week without them.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.title: The Surprising Power of Liberating Structures
